business_model.narrative_summary: Arvind Fashions is transitioning from a traditional multi-brand apparel distributor into a premium direct-to-consumer fashion platform with stronger margins, better cash flows, and higher ROCE potential.

capital_allocation_philosophy.narrative: Management has focused on consolidating control over high-growth assets and exiting loss-making labels.

execution_track_record.narrative: Management has delivered on the 'Power Brand' strategy, improving margins and cleaning up the brand portfolio.

forward_guidance.narrative: Management targets 12-15% revenue growth and continued EBITDA expansion.

communication_transparency.narrative: AFL maintains high transparency in its consolidation of joint ventures.

governance_and_board.narrative: Management has a clean fraud/scandal history with no material regulatory issues reported.
